control.$description: Short controls: inputs, set chip, check box, search field, floating button. Estimated, plus or minus 2 pt.

button.$description: Full-width buttons and dialog buttons. Estimated, plus or minus 2 pt.

card.$description: Routine card, stat card, dashboard tile. Estimated, plus or minus 2 pt.

full.$description: Chips, badges, switch, pills. The doc says 'full round'; 999 is a stand-in for a capsule.

xs.$description: Scale step completed around the measured 16 pt and 18 pt; not read from a capture.

sm.$description: Scale step; not read from a capture.

md.$description: Scale step; the measured gap between set-table controls is 11 pt.

lg.$description: Scale step equal to the measured screen margin and grid gap.

xl.$description: Scale step; not read from a capture.

cardPadding.$description: Card at x 16, button inside at x 34.

setRow.$description: Set table row pitch: 36 pt controls plus an 11 pt gap.

control.$description: Set-number chip, check box and the square controls in a set row.

primary.$description: The doc reads 39 to 40 pt; 40 is used.

timerBar.$description: Rest timer bar, docked at the bottom, 390 wide.

timer.$description: Accent line on the rest timer bar's top edge.

workout.$description: Accent line under the nav bar while a workout runs.

picker.$description: Image circle in an exercise picker row.

selection.$description: Selection tick badge on a picker row image.

width.$description: Full-width control: screen minus two 16 pt margins.
One cell of the two-up grid.

height.$description: 'Add 2 exercises', 356 wide, pinned above the home indicator.

base.$description: The shipped face is unknown: a geometric sans with circular 'o' and a two-storey 'a', not SF Pro. The Behance concept board used Poppins, which looks similar, but that is the concept author's choice and not confirmed for the app. 'system' means: use the platform face and expect slightly different widths.

regular.$description: Weight step. The doc names the weights as regular, medium, semibold and bold without numbers.

medium.$description: Weight step. The doc names the weights as regular, medium, semibold and bold without numbers.

semibold.$description: Weight step. The doc names the weights as regular, medium, semibold and bold without numbers.

bold.$description: Weight step. The doc names the weights as regular, medium, semibold and bold without numbers.

navTitle.$description: Nav bar title ('Settings', 'Explore'). About 17 pt, regular or medium; medium used.

cardTitle.$description: Card and exercise titles. About 17 pt, semibold.

link.$description: Exercise name link in the accent colour. About 16 pt, semibold.

body.$description: Body, row titles, button labels. The doc says about 15 to 16 pt, regular or medium; 16 regular used.

bodySecondary.$description: Secondary lines (muscle group, exercise list in a card). About 15 pt, regular.

label.$description: Small labels ('Duration'). The doc says about 12 to 13 pt; 13 used.

columnHeader.$description: Set table column headers ('SET', 'KG'). About 12 pt, caps.

timerDigits.$description: Rest timer mm:ss digits, about 28 pt in the heading colour. The doc gives no weight; 600 is a guess.

notTokenised: Corner smoothing (iOS continuous corners are not a DTCG value)
Shadows (none seen; separation comes from fills and 1 pt borders)
Motion and easing (not captured, stills only)

grouped.$description: Settings section bands and the top area. Dark uses the page black here; the rows are raised instead.

card.$description: Card fill (routine card, stat card). Light separates a card from the page with color.border.card; dark with the fill alone.

raised.$description: Neutral fill for anything tappable that is not primary: secondary buttons, search field, filter buttons, unselected chips, tiles, set-number chip, check box. In dark it is also the fill of settings rows, dialogs and the timer bar.

raised2.$description: Second raised level: buttons inside a dialog or the rest timer bar, filter tiles. Light has no second level in the capture, so it reuses the neutral fill (Derived).

sheet.$description: Bottom and action sheets. Light was not captured (the detail pages were dark only), so light takes the page white (Derived).

sheetFilter.$description: Filter sheets, slightly darker than other sheets in dark. The rest timer and date wheel sheets read the same value (p18, t70). Light was not captured (Derived as white).

wheelBand.$description: Selected band of a wheel picker. Light was not captured, so it takes the neutral fill (Derived).

card.$description: 1 pt card border. Dark cards drop the border (transparent, Derived from the doc's statement that dark has none).

input.$description: Weight and reps input border, and the segmented control container border. Dark is 'about #1E1E1E'.

divider.$description: List row divider. Light is '#F9F9F9 or lighter', barely visible. The doc has no dark divider; #111111 is the 1 pt line read from d06 while building this package.

heading.$description: Large titles and the timer digits. A navy-black in light, not pure black.

body.$description: Row titles, card titles, settings labels.

secondary.$description: Section labels, subtitles, column headers. Dark is a range, #64666A to #696B6F; the first value is used.

tertiary.$description: Placeholders, previous values, empty-state icon. Light is a range, #AAAFB2 to #B7BABC; dark is #4A4A4A to #626468. The first value of each range is used.

onAccent.$description: Label on accent fills. The doc says 'white label' without a hex, so this is Derived.

default.$description: The one accent: primary buttons, selected chip, links, check badge, active tab. Unchanged in dark.

glass.$description: Accent as it shows through the iOS 26 glass Finish pill. The dark value was not read; assumed unchanged (Derived).

focus.$description: Focus ring on an input (about 1.5 pt). Light is 'accent' in the doc, so it is Derived from accent.default; dark is about #0077E4.

success.$description: Completed set check box fill. Dark uses its own green, not the light hex.

successRowTint.$description: Background of a ticked set row.

successChip.$description: Set-number chip on a ticked row.

live.$description: 'Live Sync Active' and in-progress dot. The dark value was not read; assumed unchanged (Derived). Close to dark state.success (#36B434).

destructive.$description: Discard label, trash icon, Delete and Remove items. Dark is 'about #DE3F34'.

failure.$description: Failure set type 'F'. Only dark was read (#E13F34); light takes the destructive red (Derived).

drop.$description: Drop set type 'D', a cyan separate from the accent. Only dark was read; light assumed unchanged (Derived).

tip.$description: Inline tip banner. Unchanged in dark.

gold.$description: Rank 1 medal. Read in dark only; light assumed unchanged (Derived).

silver.$description: Rank 2 medal. Read in dark only; light assumed unchanged (Derived).

bronze.$description: Rank 3 medal. Read in dark only; light assumed unchanged (Derived).

scrim.$description: Dim behind dialogs, black at about 70%. The light capture shows #434343 over white, which works out nearer 74%; 70% (B3) is the documented figure.

offTrack.$description: Switch track when off. The doc says only 'light grey'; both values were read from the captures while building this package.

disabledGlass.$description: Disabled Save glass pill. Dark was not captured; borrowed from switch.offTrack as the nearest disabled grey (Derived).

notTokenised: Glass blur and refraction on the tab bar and nav pills (iOS 26 system material)

$themes.name: Light
$themes.$description: Appearance: Light (Settings > Preferences > Theme). Read from screenshots/light/.

$themes.name: Dark
$themes.$description: Appearance: Dark. Read from screenshots/dark/ and screenshots/pages/ (the detail pages were captured in dark only).

heading.$description: h1 color, the black hero line.

accent.$description: Computed color of the hero line Get Stronger.

link.$description: Log in link color. Same rgb as the hero accent.

linkHover.$description: A second blue on in-page links such as How to Get Started.

searchButton.$description: Exercise library search button. A third blue, not the hero accent.

family.$description: Computed font-family on body. The webfont file is not in the repo.

signup.$description: Sign Up computed border-radius. The painted corner reads as 12px; the computed value is 11.3213px.

search.$description: Exercise library search field bounding box. Width is the field, not a token.
